doc: Verification status of each capability on each platform (release plan §2.5, D-201). status: real (run on real hardware or a real system service), software (run on a software implementation or a virtual device: correctness, not performance), unverified (implemented to the contract, its own tests and the CPU reference pass, but no environment to run this path here: neither a pass nor a red, not evidence), unsupported (the capability query says no). real and software name their evidence (a case, a script, a run); unverified says what is missing; a tier-1 stable cell that is unverified says what graduates it. omui-devtools platforms writes docs/{en,zh}/platforms.md from this file.

capability.name: An application's first frame: process start to the window's first pixels (RC3.6)
capability.label: stable

linux-x64.evidence: example 01, release, `--frames 1` (the window asked for to its first frame shown), RTX 4080 under SDL's offscreen driver, 2026-11-17: the CPU renderer 41–53 ms warm (185 ms cold; the whole process 150–270 ms); the GPU renderer 207–334 ms warm (784 ms cold), its device and pipelines made before the first frame. Since then the device is made on a thread of its own from the host's start, beside its fonts, runtime and window: the same dev build interleaved A/B under the same load, 209–328 ms against 403–596 ms before. Not yet held by a CI row
